Historical/numerical context on finite zeta zeros; no numerical proof dependency.
Jensen and elementary complex analysis; imported analytic APIs and local exact adapters replace citation-only reasoning.
Required deep arithmetic bound for actual cusp eigenvalues; still an open formalization input.
Predecessor/support context; not the concentration theorem or a Lean dependency.
Positive Stieltjes measures and measure theory; actual one-sided derivative measure construction is implemented.
Different finite-height regime; no coupled limit imported into the target.
Continuous Kronecker–Weyl context; actual prime flow equidistribution and density proved locally.
Classical newform/eigenvalue normalization; genuine old/newspace and Hecke objects implemented, automorphic bridge still separate.
Theorems 5,7,31; retained printed p.275 fixes the open-strip convention. Finite-polynomial proof obligations are implemented locally.
Definition/background for independent uniform-circle variables; actual probability law and independence consumed in Lean.
Context about zeros of infinite L-functions; not a theorem about finite-polynomial zeros.
Context: Dedekind-zeta partial sums; not part of the required application scope.
Context: symmetrized approximations with a dual term; not the raw truncation in this project.
Context: extreme zeros of fixed finite approximations; distinct from normalized vertical mass.
Context: broad support is compatible with concentration of vertical mass.
Required genuine mean-square asymptotic input, including a positive leading constant; still open.
Convex slopes and compact-uniform convergence; actual convexity and derivative inequalities are proved/consumed locally.
Context: zero-free regions and counts for partial L-functions.
Context: existence and support of Dirichlet-polynomial zeros.
